payload.claim: This sentence says `SA-0288` (the spec this diff implements) "builds it. Until it lands, the gate suite holds `witness` advisory at `standard`." This diff is exactly SA-0288 landing: `_advisory` in `saffron/gates/suite.py` no longer adds `witness` to the advisory set at any tier. After this merges the sentence is false (the gate suite no longer holds `witness` advisory at `standard`), and nothing in the diff updates it even though DESIGN.md is cited as authoritative and specs read it by section number.
